rows.text: The key to piloting Jenova, Ancient Calamity is understanding its core engine: Jenova targets a creature each combat to place +1/+1 counters equal to Jenova's power and make it a Mutant. When that Mutant dies on your turn, you draw cards equal to its power, creating a self-fueling card draw and sacrifice engine.

This is a Bracket 3 build running three Game Changers: Demonic Tutor, Vampiric Tutor, Ancient Tomb. It contains zero mass land denial and focuses on high-synergy board development, interactive answers, and an inevitable endgame clock.
